Point
rows: ==First independent Muslim kingdom of the Deccan==
Fort ==**Asirgarh**==, taken by Akbar **1601**; Tapti valley

boxes.title: Rulers: added detail
items: Sikandar of Kashmir (**1389-1413**): temples destroyed, Brahmins driven out
Zain-ul-Abidin (**1420-1470**): original name ==**Shahi Khan**==; temples rebuilt, Brahmins called back
**Jonaraja** continued the Rajatarangini; **Zaina Lank** island in **Wular** lake
**Husain Shah Sharqi**: Sufi musician ==**Pir Bodhan**==; Sharqi court patronised **Khyal**

boxes.title: Mahmud Gawan: more
items: Strengthened centre; cut provincial nobles' power
Quelled Telangana revolts (**1453** onward) with ==**Velama**== help
Framed by rival nobles → break-up of the kingdom

boxes.title: More monuments
head: Monument
Point
rows: Three-storey facade, blue tiles; also **Jama Masjid, Jaunpur**
Baz Bahadur's Palace, Rupmati's pavilion, **Ashrafi Mahal**

boxes.title: Wars & chronicles: more
items: Begarha (**1458-1511**): "two forts"; with Egypt vs Portuguese: **Chaul 1508**, lost at ==**Diu 1509**==
Bahadur Shah (**1526-37**): annexed Malwa **1531**, attacked **Chittor 1535**, beaten by **Humayun**
**Mirat-i-Sikandari**: by **Sikandar bin Muhammad**; ==Mahmud Begada's prosperity== + administration
Jaunpur school: **1394-1479**; Rana Sanga lost at **Khanwa** (**1527**)

boxes.title: Current: Kalaburagi
items: Jama Masjid: "Asia's second-largest mosque", modelled on ==**Cordoba**==
Bidriware: 14th c. Bahmani craft; PM's diplomatic gift
